source.citation: Edwards’ Annual Directory of the City of Chicago, 1871. Fourteenth annual issue. Chicago: Richard Edwards, 1871.
what_it_does_not_supply: Modern coordinates, measured footprints, facades, exact people present at 16:30 or guaranteed October occupancy for every listing.
what_it_supplies: Occupations, business categories, institution names and historical addresses for further location research.
Evidence for varied commercial, residential and industrial uses.
